hypothesis: Do inflation-linked Treasuries on a trend rule give inflation protection that can step aside?
rules: 100% TIP when TIP has at least 2 of 3 trend votes (the Atlas trend votes: how many of 'close above its own close 63, 126 and 252 sessions ago' hold (core_v1.votes)), else 100% BIL. The same function as D-GOLD and D-OIL (families.trend_one).
leverage: no borrowing: weights add to at most 100% (max_gross 1.0). Effective exposure above 1x only through 2x funds.
fills: decision after a session close, filled at the next session's open (twins engine = research_harness/harness/portfolio.simulate)
costs: one shared model for every line: twins.config.SHARE_COSTS = 0 commission, 2 bps half spread, 3 bps slippage per trade (estimates; monthly re-measure from the real accounts' fills is a later work order). Gearing only through 2x funds (SSO, QLD), whose borrowing cost is inside their price; no margin. Idle money in BIL (T-bills); plain cash earns 0.
data_needed: TIP and SPY (calendar) daily bars + BIL
window: forward only: version 1 from its registration (the lock, or intake 1) to 31 Dec 2027. A replay of history (roadmap v2, V2-02) is planned before the lock; until it reports, no backtest stands behind this line.
